en.title: Rust-Stained Tracks: Tear Through the Wind
en.premise: There are men who strive to be the fastest on the mountain passes, driving legendary classic cars on the brink of being scrapped. To bring back to life the motionless machine left by my late father, I grip the steering wheel once more. The goal is a perilous hill climb race, ending at an ancient lighthouse perched on a cliff. My father's final words were simple: "Seize the wind." Igniting the rusted engine, I accelerate beyond the limit.

zh.title: 铁锈之辙，撕裂之风
zh.premise: 有一群男人，驾驶着曾被誉为传说、如今却近乎报废的老车，追求在山路上的极致速度。为了让亡父留下的那辆无法启动的老车再次奔跑，我重新握住了方向盘。目标是那场以断崖之上的古老灯塔为终点、赌上性命的爬山赛。父亲的遗言只有简单的一句：“抓住风。”点燃锈迹斑斑的引擎，我向着极限之外加速。
